unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፭ — Meraf 5: Advanced Mastery of ዐ and ዘ

success_screen.headline_en: Brilliant! You solved the advanced ዐ and ዘ challenges!
success_screen.headline_am: ድንቅ ነው! የላቁትን የዐ እና የዘ ፈተናዎችን በብልሃት ጨረሱ!

games.title: Word Assembly: ዓይን
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters to build the word for Eye!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 'ዓ', then 'ይ' (6th form), and end with 'ን'!

games.title: Word Finish: ዜብራ
games.instructions_en: Look at the incomplete word for 'Zebra': ዜ[ ? ]ራ. Choose the correct missing middle letter!
games.tips_en: The full word is ዜብራ (pronounced Ze-b-ra).

games.title: Audio Blend: ዒ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the sound blend. Which symbol represents the exact 'Ee' (3rd form) sound for Ain?
games.target_phonetic_description: The 3rd form ('I' vowel sound): 'Ii' as in 'Ayin'

games.title: Word Assembly: ዛፍ
games.tips_en: Tip: Start with fourth form 'ዛ', followed by sixth form 'ፍ'!

games.title: Word Finish: ዓሳ
games.instructions_en: Find the missing letter to complete the word for 'Fish': ዓ[ ? ].
games.tips_en: The full word is ዓሳ (pronounced A-sa).

games.title: Audio Blend: ዙ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely. Which symbol represents the 'Zu' sound?

games.title: Word Assembly: ዘውድ
games.tips_en: Tip: Start with first form 'ዘ', middle sixth form 'ው', and end with 'ድ'!

games.title: Word Finish: ዓመት
games.tips_en: The full word is ዓመት (pronounced A-met).
